This supports the 'structural collapse' finding—the AI has fused separate objects into one topological entity.

The severity of the building artifact is likely underestimated by the Router (2.0); it represents a fundamental failure to render man-made geometry, contrasting sharply with the natural landscape. I will adjust the artifact score to reflect this structural incoherence more heavily.
